name: ZTHR team minimum
what: The starting point every app from this team inherits, whatever its intent says: what the title block, the evidence and the people who run the app need. A team defines it once; the fleet maintains it, and every app that inherits it gets each update.

parts.why: Every journey on the drawing is locked by hash and walked by the factory
